title: Ask an aside without interrupting
done: That is it: the question becomes a Discuss request, which the agent answers when its current step ends.

steps.caption: An aside is a quick question about a row, answered by a copy of the agent while the agent works on.
Right-click the row you are asking about.

steps.text: Why run the tests in the background?
steps.caption: Type your question.
Press Ask aside. The agent itself is not interrupted.

request.aside: So that the agent can check the code style while the tests run; it is told when they finish.

steps.caption: A copy of the session answers in a few seconds.
The answer shows under the row. The copy has no tools, so it explains rather than checks.
Your turn: press Ask the agent instead, to put the same question to the agent itself.
